faqs.q: Can foreigners buy property in Mauritius?
faqs.a: Yes, through approved schemes for international buyers. Each listing shows whether it's open to international buyers; we confirm eligibility with your notary before any offer.

faqs.q: Do I need to be in Mauritius to buy?
faqs.a: No. Many buyers visit once or view by video, and sign through a power of attorney.

faqs.q: What costs come on top of the price?
faqs.a: Usually registration duty, notary and legal fees. We give you a full estimate for each property before you make an offer.

faqs.q: Can you manage the property when I'm away?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with trusted local partners for rentals, maintenance and gardens.
